title: Expired in-progress task cannot be reclaimed through worker MCP
context_notes: Product-test evidence on 2026-09-09: TASK-EFF.2 lease expired at 18:01:06, but vibesync_claim_task returned TOOL_ERROR saying it remains in_progress under codex-usertest. Worker MCP exposes no release/expire operation, so the required ordered roadmap cannot continue without an administrator recovery action. This directly informs TASK-EFF.6 stale lease detection and auto-release.
